title: Runbook Cardlets: Interactive Sandbox Visuals for Optimize Toolkit Quickstart
creator: Ava Chen
description: Deliver a set of compact, self-contained "cardlet" assets and annotated screenshots for the Optimize quickstart that live inside the Console onboarding flow and docs. Each cardlet is a single-step interactive visual that explains a specific optimization: batching heuristics, prefix/KV cache benefits, and quantization presets. The goal is a minimal learning surface for first-time users so they can: 1) see immediate cost/latency tradeoffs, 2) toggle recommended presets, and 3) export a recommended config to the API/SDK. This ticket covers: art direction, microcopy, annotated screenshot capture, and handoff slices for FE implementation and docs authors.
acceptance_criteria: Three unique cardlet designs: Batching Preview, KV Cache Snapshot, Quant Presets (each with desktop + mobile screenshot)
Each cardlet includes: one inline micrograph showing relative cost/latency, a 2-option toggle (Default / Recommended), and a tooltip with 'Why this matters' microcopy
Annotated Figma frames and a 1-page design handoff sheet with CSS/spacing tokens
Design review signoff from Eng lead (Diego Morales) and PM (Liam O'Neill)
Assets exported at 2x PNG and SVG, plus a small animated GIF demo for the batching toggle
